Our story

A place for craft.
A space for stories.

LikhaLoka is a student website concept built around a simple idea — make Filipino craftsmanship easier to discover, and give the people behind it room to tell their stories.

Discover more than a piece.

Browse a collection, learn about the maker, and begin a conversation. We want each listing to connect an object with the care, time, and creativity behind it.

Stories shared with care.

Real profiles should be created with artisan consent and reviewed for accurate attribution. Materials, techniques, regional origins, and cultural meanings should be confirmed with the makers and appropriate cultural sources.

About this prototype

The listings, workshop names, descriptions, and AI-generated craft images are illustrative. Cultural references and real image credits will be added when participating artisans and verified sources are selected.
